what: Ask for a Google Play rating at a happy moment: on the finish screen after a new record, from the 5th workout on, using Play's own in-app rating box (at most once every few months)
why: The app never asks for a rating anywhere; the only way to speak up is the feedback box. Hevy and Strong ask in-app after good workouts (as known by Jun 2026, not re-checked live).
impact_why: Store rating and review count drive Play installs; members who just set a record are the happiest to rate
my_view: My view: do it; Play's own box is one call, never a full-screen nag, and the record moment already exists.

what: Show "Your workouts are only on this phone" on the finish screen of the 3rd workout, not only as the last of the Workout tab's notices
why: The card sits last in an 8-notice queue and waits a whole day once any other notice is closed, so a member can train for weeks without seeing it while their history is at risk.
impact_why: A lost or reset phone loses every workout; the finish screen is the moment the member cares most
my_view: My view: do it; same words and button, one more place, shown once.

what: Warn before a week streak breaks: one quiet nudge on Saturday evening when this week has no workout yet ("One workout by Sunday keeps your 6 weeks in a row")
why: The streak counts weeks in a row but nothing tells the member it is about to end; they find out after it is gone.
impact_why: Streak-at-risk nudges are the cheapest pull-back for members drifting off in week 3 to 6
my_view: My view: do it only for members who already allow reminders, once a week at most, and only for streaks of 3+ weeks.

what: Give one "holiday week" every 3 months that keeps the week streak alive (Diwali, travel, illness)
why: One week with no workout resets a 20-week streak to zero; for Indian members festival and travel weeks are normal, and a broken long streak often ends the habit.
impact_why: Protects the members with the longest habit, who are the ones most likely to stay to day 30 and beyond
my_view: My view: worth discussing; keep it automatic (the first empty week in 3 months is forgiven) so nobody has to manage it.

what: Add "Recommend MettleUp to my gym" to the free month's "5 days left" and "has ended" pop-ups, using the existing share message
why: Both pop-ups tell members that gym members get Plus free (or list what is now paid), but give no way to act on it; the recommend-to-gym share lives only on the Gym tab's no-gym screen.
impact_why: The moment a member loses features is the moment they most want their gym on MettleUp; each share is a gym-owner lead
my_view: My view: do it when Plus is switched on; it reuses the share text that already exists, one button.

what: Start the free month on the first finished workout, not on the first app open
why: The free month starts the day the app first opens with the plan switch on, so a member who installs, looks around and starts training a week later has lost a week of the trial before using it.
impact_why: A full month of real training is what shows the paid features' worth; fewer members hit "ended" before they formed the habit
my_view: My view: do it before Plus is switched on; a small change to when the day is set.

what: Keep a help message that could not be sent and send it by itself when the internet is back, instead of "Couldn't send. Try again"
why: A member in a gym basement with weak signal must remember to come back and press Send again; many never will, and the team never hears the problem.
impact_why: Gym floors often have poor signal, which is exactly where members hit problems
my_view: My view: do it; show it in "Your questions" as "Waiting to send" so the member sees it was kept.

what: Let the floating feedback button add a picture of the screen it was opened from (member can remove it before Send)
why: The message carries the screen's name but no picture, so the team often has to ask what the member saw; a screenshot settles most reports in one look.
impact_why: Cuts back-and-forth on every bug report during the early-days period when the button is on for everyone
my_view: My view: worth doing; off by default with a clear "Add a picture of this screen" tick, so nothing private goes without a choice, and the privacy notice says so.

what: When a member taps "No" on "Did this solve it?", offer "Tell me when the team answers" and ask for notification permission right there
why: The team's answer pops up only on Android and only when notifications were already allowed; otherwise the member must remember to reopen Help to find it.
impact_why: A reply nobody reads is support work wasted, and an unanswered member is likely to leave
my_view: My view: do it; asking at the moment the member wants an answer is when people say yes.

what: If the coach comes back, write its suggested-weight reasons in the member's own unit (kg or lb)
why: The coach's reasons are written with kg in the words ("start with the empty bar (20 kg)", "starting light at 7.5 kg"), so a pound user would read kg inside the coach.
impact_why: Only matters once the hidden coach is shown again, and only for pound users
my_view: My view: park it with the coach; fix it in the same change that turns the coach back on.
